title: Afternoon traffic and safety

items.label: SR-85 NB · Saratoga Ave
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB SR-85 just south of the Saratoga Ave offramp (San Jose / Campbell), ~1:48 PM PT (CHP #1448). Tarp blocking lane 1; no responsible vehicle seen; unit assigned ~2:25 PM; still active ~2:25 PM. Relevant to Campbell / Union Ave approaches on NB 85.

items.label: I-280 NB · Race St
items.text: Still on board: multi-vehicle collision on NB I-280 at the Race St offramp, San Jose (~1:23 PM). Affects 280 near downtown SJ / Race exit.

items.label: SR-85 NB · Evelyn Ave
items.text: Still on board: collision with ambulance en route on NB SR-85 just south of Evelyn Ave, Mountain View (~1:29 PM). Affects NB 85 north of Campbell.
